skill_name: Compose a story about a tour guide who takes visitors around a haunted castle.
workflow: Larry was a tour guide in a mysterious castle said to be haunted. The castle was built hundreds of years ago and it seemed to have some magical powers. Every weekend, Larry would take visitors on a tour, narrating stories and tales of the castle’s rich history. On one particular tour, Larry felt a chill unlike any other—he quickly realized it was supernatural! He decided to take the tourists a step further and take them to the inner chambers of the castle.
